title: Elon Musk's X settles multiyear legal battle with the World Federation of Advertisers | TechCrunch
summary: Elon Musk’s X has settled its multiyear legal battle with advertising trade group the World Federation for Advertisers (WFA), the two organizations said on Wednesday. WFA will not form or restart GARM or a similar initiative.
